Context: G. Sunderban Allowance

Sunderban Allowance categorized as Tough Location Allowance-Ill is admissible to ·civilian employees working in Sunderban areas South of Dampier Hodge's line, namely, Bhagatush Khali (Rampura), Kumirmari (Bagna), Ihinga.Khali, Sajnakhali, Gosaba, Amlamathi (Bidya), Canning, Kultali, Piyali, Nalgaraha, Raidighi, Bhanchi, Pathar Paratima, Bhagabatpur, Saptamukhi, Namkhana, Sikarpur, Kakdwip, Sagar, Mousini, Kalinagar, Haroa, Hingalganj, Basanti, .Kuemari, Kultola, Ghusighata (Kulti) area.
